title: Portrait With Subtle Natural Motion
tests: Tests restrained portrait animation with temporal identity preservation rather than facial drift or a static-image zoom.

faults.what: The soundtrack contains transcribed speech, "こんにちは", despite the explicit request for no sound.

judge.summary: The portrait stays visually consistent with restrained movement, but unwanted speech violates the silence requirement and the sampled frames do not verify a natural blink.

must_haves.item: The woman remains recognizably the same person as in the attachment across the entire clip.
must_haves.why: She is recognizably the source woman in all supplied output frames.

must_haves.item: A natural blink and subtle breathing movement are visible.
must_haves.why: Small shoulder and neckline changes are consistent with subtle breathing, but her eyes are open in every supplied frame, so a blink between samples cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: Her face does not morph, drift, develop asymmetry or change identity between frames.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames show stable facial structure without obvious morphing, new asymmetry or identity changes.

must_haves.item: Her curly dark hair, sweater and park setting remain consistent with the source.
must_haves.why: The dark curls, gray knitted sweater and park background remain consistent throughout the samples.

must_haves.item: The square framing and camera stay fixed in a silent video lasting approximately 5 seconds.
must_haves.why: The square composition and background remain fixed, and 5.2 seconds is approximately the requested duration, but the supplied audio report identifies speech rather than silence.
